standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme-theoretic unions and the union sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies 0 -> O_X -> O_Y (+) O_Z -> O_{Y cap Z} -> 0 for X = Y  union  Z and the kernel descriptions of the ideal sheaves used in the diagram chase.

standard_prerequisites.name: Duality for 1-dimensional CM closed subschemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma lemma-duality-dim-1 for the dualizing modules and Lemma lemma-closed-immersion-dim-1-CM; Duality for Schemes, Lemma duality-lemma-gorenstein
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes omega_X invertible on the Gorenstein X, identifies i_*omega_Y as SheafHom(i_*O_Y, omega_X), and trivializes omega_X over the 0-dimensional intersection.

core_obligations: Cohen-Macaulay property and the union sequence (proof lines 1052-1062): reduced 1-dimensional Noetherian schemes are CM; X = Y union Z scheme-theoretically with 0 -> O_X -> O_Y (+) O_Z -> O_{Y cap Z} -> 0.

Ideal bookkeeping (proof lines 1064-1085): the four ideal sheaves are the kernels of the four maps in the union diagram; a diagram chase proves (2) (I = i_*I', J = j_*J'), and the additional relations I + J = ideal of Y meet Z and I cap J = 0 yield six exact sequences on structure sheaves.

Duality sequences (proof lines 1087-1100): omega_X invertible and trivial on the 0-dimensional Y  cap  Z; once (3) is proven, tensoring the structure-sheaf sequences by omega_X produces all six exact sequences of the lemma; by symmetry it suffices to prove i_*(omega_Y) = J omega_X.

Annihilator identification (proof lines 1102-1112): i_*omega_Y = SheafHom(i_*O_Y, omega_X) by lemma-closed-immersion-dim-1-CM; since omega_X is invertible this reduces to SheafHom(O_X/I, O_X) mapping to J by evaluation at 1, i.e. J is the annihilator of I, which follows from the relations above.
proof_roadmap: Get the union sequence and the four ideal-kernel descriptions; do the diagram chase for (2).
Record I + J and I cap J and write the six structure-sheaf sequences.
Reduce to (3) by symmetry; reduce (3) to the annihilator statement i_*(omega_Y) = J omega_X.
Prove the annihilator identification via SheafHom and evaluation at 1, then tensor everything by omega_X.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the duality bookkeeping engine for decomposing a Gorenstein curve into a closed subscheme and its complement (statement lines 1011-1049 with six exact sequences). The proof (lines 1051-1112) assembles: the CM fact and the union sequence, a diagram chase identifying the ideal sheaves with their pushed-forward restrictions, the relations I + J and I  cap  J giving six sequences, the reduction by symmetry to one duality statement, and the annihilator identification via SheafHom and evaluation at 1. H3: the sequence bookkeeping and the two-step reduction to the annihilator statement are a genuine argument.
